## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Choppy: CPER in RECOVERY (1W: +2.48% | 1M: -6.88%), GLD in RECOVERY (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.89%), SLV in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -20.82%) — short-term gains against weaker 1M trends.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -7.17%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -24.92%), UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -0.17%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Financials and Biotech leadership with XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) and XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (SPY RECOVERY, XLK RECOVERY vs TLT CORRECTION and multiple sector 1W/1M mismatches) — suppresses a strong regime call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to cyclicals and select growth pockets showing strength (XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%)); reduce exposure to energy and China (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -7.17%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -8.86%)). Monitor bond/volatility signals (TLT CORRECTION (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.43%); VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.78% | 1M: -9.93%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%) and XLV (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +8.39%) if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -7.17%) and FXI (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -8.86%) on continued weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.48% | 1M: -6.88%) and GLD (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.89%) for safe-haven/industrial signals. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -24.92%) and UNG (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -0.17%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -5.78% | 1M: -9.93%) — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.15%) vs LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -0.08%) — monitor HYG/LQD spread for credit risk. XLK (1W: +1.40% | 1M: -5.07%) vs XLF (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) — XLK/XLF cross as style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. XBI and XLF showing relative strength while energy and China (XLE, FXI) show weakness; key risk is the major 1W/1M divergence across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, TLT) to monitor.
